text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to have a new laboratory to test the quality and standard of medicines.
- The World Gold Council will set up a regional training institute for goldsmiths in Bahrain.
- The private sector in Bahrain and other Gulf Arab states is set to open talks with the European Union in a bid for fairer trade practice.
- Finnish national carrier Finnair to start tourist flights to Bahrain from October.
- Prime minister gets a message from newly-elected British premier, Tony Blair, aimed at boosting relations between the two countries.
- Aluminium Bahrain plans to borrow $85 million to finance three projects.
- A Russian delegation is expected in Bahrain next week on a four-day visit to boost economic cooperation.
